body: https://konard.github.io/network/?code=0201&turns=0+45%2C0+45 - here we clearly have the problem with links to be fully overlapping each other in default static arrangement, so here we should clearly add fixes, so the 0 degree turn is like it set here, meaning we should redefine here what 0 means, and also check similar cases where lines fully overlap each other like in https://konard.github.io/network/?code=0201, also double check we don't break any perfect arrangement we did here, but in this case we clearly have a kind of a regression. ``` settings: motion.mode off sound.on false corner.buttonCorners own corner.menuCorners 'own' corner.buttonEdgeStyle dotted corner.buttonTlLine accent corner.buttonTlSize 6 corner.buttonTrSize 6 corner.buttonBrShape square corner.buttonBrSize 6 corner.buttonBlLine 'accent' corner.buttonBlSize 6 corner.menuEdges none corner.menuEdgeStyle solid corner.menuTlShape 'square' corner.menuTlSize 6 corner.menuTrSize 6 corner.menuBrShape 'square' corner.menuBrSize 6 corner.menuBlSize 6 ``` We should add new defaults like this. Also these should be renamed to drop down list, and I didn't find any configuration for top level menu, second level menu and so on. We need to make sure all UI elements with borders are configurable. Also in `CORNERS OF THE FRAME` we should always see the preview of what we configuring at the moment right in this panel, so user always sees it. We also need to add configuration of borders on hover, focus, outline and so on. We also need to speed up switching between animation disable/enable. Also any changes to borders should not affect redrawing the animation on the background at all. The animation should not be re-rerendered on animation stop/start, we just need to start/stop it on next frame and that is it. All this thing should control is animations actually running or not, it is bad idea to lock the UI for prerendering of separate background version with no animation. We should make our UI fast and responsive, and do minimum of actions with same visuals. Also in settings we have big gap to the left, so we may need to rearrange blocks of settings so it is easier to do configurations. In panels like this: We should make markings on the left to be configurable, and by default to make them more transparent or make padding/margin so they don't overlap with borders at all, and we have at least 1 px of offset from borders, so they look nice if not transparent, and also make ability to make them semi transparent, so it is configurable and next time I will select the more perfect way here, but for now you can choose what is the best practice, yet everything should be configurable. And gaps in the middle of the text should be removed, all text should be aligned to top, and tech can be aligned at bottom, or may be we should size them to content, so they are different sizes vertically. Double check all of these is also configurable, but we should never have gaps in the middle of text as it clearly a bug, or make it also configurable may be in some cases we will need it. We need to download all logs and data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), in which we will reconstruct timeline/sequence of events, list of each and all requirements from the issue, find root causes of the each problem, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions). If there is not enough data to find actual root cause, add debug output and verbose mode if not present, that will allow us to find root cause on next iteration. If issue related to any other repository/project, where we can report issues on GitHub, please do so. Each issue must contain reproducible examples, workarounds and suggestions for fix the issue in code. Also double check to fully apply requirements to entire codebase, so if we have issue in multiple places, it should be fixed in all them. Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until it is each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
